method: All source evidence read from immutable Git blobs via git show. Exact-main source hashes and ranges recorded below. Tests read but not run. No ClinicAI app/API/database/provider/VPS/production/secrets/PHI access. One independent security reviewer assessed the destructive-scope candidate.
result: Added conditional MEDIUM OPS-011: admin-only test-customer cleanup lacks server-side test-record/test-clinic predicate despite confirmation/preview and archive. Extended CLIN-053 for possible duplicate reminder marker if POST is retried after uncertain outcome; no new CLIN ID. No new finding in Telegram/notification, quote BFF, ThaiKy/clinical BFF, historical Notion or assigned operations/finance BFF paths; deduplicated with INF-012/023/025, LAB-001/SEC-003, FIN-003 and other existing access findings.

Schedule PATCH commits before best-effort CSKH POST; POST has no Idempotency-Key, does not inspect response, and catches failure without surfacing recovery. Retry after an ambiguous response can duplicate the marker.
BFF forwards Idempotency-Key only when supplied; callers without it retain the legacy non-idempotent path.
Backend idempotency guard is optional when the caller omits the key.
Selector includes every listed patient except those with an open visit today; there is no test-record predicate in this selection.
Screen says test customers and supports selecting a date up to 20 days back; deletion applies to all data on all dates.
Rows display ordinary patient identity, visit status, payments and file counts, without a visible test marker.
Preview shows patient identifiers, dates and row counts, but no test/live classification.
Capability gate requires permission.manage; this is a privileged authorized workflow, not an authorization bypass.
Delete validates confirmation, locks clinic-scoped patients and blocks open visits today, but does not validate a test-record or test-clinic marker before calling the destructive SQL function.
List SQL selects every clinic appointment and walk-in visit for a requested day, then joins ordinary patient identities and payment/file counts; no test-only predicate.
List, preview and delete endpoints are mounted under internal identity; deletion delegates to the service capability check.
SQL function verifies the selected patient belongs to the supplied clinic; it does not enforce test-only patient/clinic status.
Before deletion, affected rows are archived as JSON.
Function deletes rows from operational tables in a loop, then restores triggers; archival supports manual recovery rather than a guarded live-record boundary.
Archive table stores original deleted rows; schema comment states restoration is manual.
Read permission-denial test; tests read only, not run.
Read admin delete/retention test; test distinguishes fixture names but does not assert a server-side test-record invariant. Read only, not run.
Disabled routes return 410 before handler; no separate finding.
Proxy boundary blocks retired API paths; no separate finding in assigned slice.
Historical Notion checks content-view permission and clinic scope.
Historical note read path applies actor and patient boundaries.
Attachment metadata is checked through the service.
Attachment access is separately scoped; no BFF bypass found.
Boundary test covers retired route responses; read only, not run.

reviewer.scope: Independent security severity and duplicate assessment for OPS-011.
reviewer.result: Recommend MEDIUM, conditional on endpoint being used with real clinic data. This is missing destructive data-type boundary, not authorization bypass. permission.manage, preview, XOA, open-visit block and manual JSON archive reduce occurrence/irreversibility; deployment and external test-clinic policy were not verified.

dispositions.decision: Promoted as conditional MEDIUM finding; exact static UI/service/router/SQL/test evidence recorded. No claim of production incident.
Extend existing finding only. Missing key means a retry after an ambiguous POST response can duplicate marker; no automatic retry or incident proven.
No new finding. Deduplicate dynamic HTML with INF-025, poison backlog with INF-012, multi-recipient at-least-once delivery with INF-023.
No distinct authorization finding in reviewed quote route and capacity parameter test.
No new bypass; disabled legacy routes return 410; upload concerns deduplicate LAB-001/SEC-003; ThaiKy and history services apply relevant clinic/clinical-content checks.
Reviewed slices deduplicate with FIN-003 and existing report/shift/access findings; no separate evidence-backed candidate.

limitations: Full source audit remains incomplete; status counts are path inspection stages, not semantic or behavioral coverage.
No production deployment, live database credential, patient record, UUID discovery path or observed incident was checked.
No product owner confirmation was available on whether the cleanup endpoint is externally guaranteed test-only.
